historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 19.6% vs total-revenue 3yr CAGR 4.9% (FY2022 COVID-antiviral peak base, then divestitures) and EPS 3yr CAGR 30.7% (FY2025 EPS inflated by XDC/ATU disposal gains). All three diverge by >30%; the forward path is anchored to FY2026 guidance and backlog, not to any historical CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2020 148, FY2021 -3,135, FY2022 -622, FY2023 6,036, FY2024 7,027, FY2025 9,158 (RMB m). FY2021-22 negative on the capex surge, so 3yr and 5yr owner-FCF CAGRs are not meaningful (null). Reported FCF CAGRs are equally distorted. Continuing revenue grew 21.4% FY2025 and 48.0% in H1 2026.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 lands at the 35-39% continuing-growth guidance on the GLP-1/TIDES ramp and late-stage small-molecule D&M. The 1260H designation stays enjoined and BIOSECURE's OMB list either omits WuXi or bites only on federal contracts, so US customers (~72% of revenue) keep their commercial programmes in place but steer some new early-stage work to 'China+1' suppliers. Growth slows to low double digits in 2027-28 and mid-single digits thereafter, and margins drift down from the H1 2026 peak as commercial peptide/API pricing normalises and Western/Korean peptide capacity comes on line.
scenario_narratives.bull: WuXi wins the 1260H litigation on the merits and is kept off the OMB biotechnology-company-of-concern list; the follow-the-molecule pipeline keeps converting (commercial + Phase III projects compounding), oral and injectable GLP-1 volumes keep growing, and the >130,000L peptide build plus the new Changzhou site fill. Revenue compounds ~20% then high-teens/low-teens, and scale holds EBITDA margins near 47-49% for most of the decade.
scenario_narratives.bear: The US re-designates WuXi on sturdier grounds or OMB lists it under BIOSECURE section 851, and large-pharma customers -- led by the dominant GLP-1 programme(s) behind the 2025-26 step-up -- dual-source or move commercial supply out of China once validated alternative capacity exists. FY2026 is already largely booked, but FY2027 revenue falls ~8% and stays flat in 2028, utilisation of the newly built capacity collapses (D&A rises as a share of revenue), pricing competition from Samsung/Lonza peptides compresses EBITDA margin to ~37%, and the market capitalises the remaining business as a domestic-plus-biotech CRO at a low multiple.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A best-in-class, net-cash CRDMO priced off a peak-margin, peak-growth year under a live US-policy overhang. The base case accepts the raised FY2026 guidance in full and then fades growth and margin; the value gap to the market is mostly the bear weight and the margin fade, not doubt about 2026.
key_risks_to_valuation: US policy: 1260H designation (enjoined, not resolved) and the forthcoming BIOSECURE section-851 OMB list
Concentration of the 2025-26 step-up in GLP-1/TIDES and a small number of commercial molecules
Margin mean-reversion from the H1 2026 44% EBIT peak as peptide capacity is added industry-wide
USD/CNY: revenue mostly USD, costs and reporting in RMB; CNY has strengthened (HKD/CNY 0.85)
Terminal value carries the bulk of EV; the cap multiple binds in base and bear

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 96.7-219.2 HKD. A-share parity from 603259.SS on the same endpoint; FX from HKDCNY=X.
data_sources.financials: 2359.HK_Metrics.csv / DuckDB core_metrics + kpis (FY2018-H1 2026); FY2025 annual report (continuing-operations income statement, cash flow, adjusted FCF reconciliation); H1 2026 interim report (balance sheet, notes 8, 10, 11, 16, 26, guidance on p.9).

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash flow statement, 'Share-based payment expenses' 801,758 (RMB'000, line 6251). No cash tax withheld on equity awards (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every period). H1 2026 SBC 274.8m (0.95% of revenue) from the interim non-IFRS reconciliation.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); H-share quoted in HKD. fx_rate 1.1758 HKD per CNY = 1/0.8505, Yahoo HKDCNY=X at 2026-10-18T02:32Z. Parity check against the A share (603259.SS, CNY 144.3 at 2026-10-16 close): H share = 196.2 x 0.8505 = CNY 166.9, i.e. H trades at a ~15.7% PREMIUM to A. Direction confirmed (CNY value x 1.1758 = HKD); the gap is a genuine A/H spread, not a rate error. Same share economics for A and H, so per-share IV applies to both lines. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate -- re-date it on the next rebuild.
inputs.share_count_basis: Issued 2,983.757m less 29.850m treasury (9.70m A-share repurchase account + 20.15m H-share treasury) = 2,953.907m participating shares at the interim report date (2026-08-03, note 11); + 51.147m H shares on full conversion of the RMB6,780m zero-coupon 2027 convertible bonds (conversion HK$153.00, deep in the money at HK$196.2 -- treated as equity, so the CB liability RMB6,585.8m is EXCLUDED from debt); + 21.05m dilutive incentive-scheme shares from the H1 2026 EPS note. Held FLAT: future SBC is expensed in the flows. The CB conversion is the only non-SBC issuance and is already in the base count.
inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY flows discounted in CNY. China 10y CGB ~1.9% + beta ~1.1 x China/EM ERP ~6.5% = ~9.0% cost of equity; company is net cash, so WACC = CoE = 9.0%. US-policy risk (BIOSECURE / 1260H) is charged in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight, NOT as a WACC premium, and WACC is identical across scenarios (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB545.5m (154.5 current + 391.0 non-current, H1 2026) included in total_debt; lease principal (~RMB204m FY2025) not deducted from flows. Immaterial either way (<0.2% of EV).
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is ~0.7% of equity (RMB550.3m at H1 2026). Flows are consolidated; NCI deducted once at book in the equity bridge.
inputs.net_cash_composition: H1 2026 (30-Jun-2026): bank balances 26,953.6 + term deposits >3m 8,747.6 + pledged deposits 24.6 + current FVTPL 'financial products' (bank wealth-management products, cash-like) 10,914.3 = 46,640.1; less the 2026 mid-year dividend RMB1,506.5m declared after the balance-sheet date and paid by 2026-09-04 = 45,133.6 cash. Debt: bank borrowings 6,182.4 + 1,798.8 = 7,981.2, + leases 545.5 = 8,526.7. Convertible bonds excluded (in the money, counted as shares).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with the non-US adaptations -- WuXi AppTec is an operating CRDMO whose value is a free-cash-flow stream; not a bank/REIT/holdco. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry). REVENUE BASIS: continuing operations. The WuXi ATU (US/UK/China cell & gene therapy) and other disposals are complete; H1 2026 total revenue equals continuing revenue (28,897.5). base_revenue is FY2025 continuing revenue RMB43,420.8m, which is also the base implied by the FY2026 guidance (total RMB58.5-60.5bn = continuing +35-39%, i.e. 43.3-43.5bn base). MARGIN ANCHOR: core operating EBIT (gross profit less S&M, admin, R&D and impairments; excludes other income incl. interest, VC fair-value gains, FX, associates) was 36.3% of continuing revenue in FY2025 and 43.9% in H1 2026; D&A 6.6% (H1 2026), SBC ~1%. FY2026 EBITDA-pre-SBC 48% assumes H2 2026 margin ~37% EBIT, consistent with management's 'stable' adjusted net margin guidance and the H1 run-rate. OWNER FCF: reported FCF is group-level (includes discontinued ops and RMB242.7m tax on the XDC stake sale); interest income stripped because net cash (RMB36.6bn) is ~4x the FCF base. FY2026 year-1 build gives ~RMB13.0bn owner FCF ex-interest against guided adjusted FCF of RMB13.5-14.5bn including ~RMB0.85bn after-tax interest income -- ties. BUYBACKS: an active repurchaser (RMB4.29bn FY2025, RMB3.16bn H1 2026, roughly 5x SBC), so the flat count is more than funded. EQUITY BRIDGE: non-current FVTPL portfolio and associates added at book because their income/gains are excluded from the flows.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 37% = midpoint of the raised 35-39% continuing guidance (H1 already +48%; backlog RMB66.4bn +25%). FY2027 14% as the GLP-1/TIDES wave and late-stage pipeline (95 commercial, 94 Phase III) keep converting but the comp gets very hard; decays to 3.5% by year 10.
base.margin_rationale: EBITDA-pre-SBC 48% FY2026 (EBIT ~40%: H1 43.9%, H2 lower on capacity ramp and FX), fading 0.5pp/yr to 43% (EBIT ~34.5%, below the FY2025 continuing 36.3%) as commercial-API pricing normalises and Lonza/Samsung peptide capacity arrives.
base.capex_rationale: FY2026 RMB8.0bn = guidance midpoint (13.4% of revenue); new Changzhou site keeps FY2027 elevated; fades to 8% vs D&A 7.5% at maturity (net growth capex for 2.5% terminal growth).
base.tax_rationale: PRC HNTE 15% plus HK 16.5% and dividend withholding; H1 2026 current tax was 18.6% of continuing PBT. Ramps to 20%.
base.wc_rationale: Manufacturer: receivables + inventory far exceed payables + contract liabilities; H1 2026 inventory +1.9bn and receivables +3.1bn against revenue growth. Growth consumes ~15% of incremental revenue.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 16x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% (from the 15% default): WuXi was placed on the DoD 1260H list in June 2026 and is protected only by a preliminary injunction, the BIOSECURE OMB list is still unpublished, and ~72% of revenue comes from US customers -- a single-regulator dependency in the plain sense. Base 45% because guidance, backlog (+25%) and the H1 print make the near-term path well evidenced. Bull trimmed to 25% because it needs a legal win, no OMB listing AND sustained GLP-1 volumes at today's margins -- several independent things going right.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
